qrcode.mjs is the unmodified qrcode-generator 2.0.4 ESM distribution (MIT).
Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
The exact npm version is locked as a dev dependency for reproducible updates.
Decoder round-trip tests use jsQR; no CDN or runtime npm installation is needed.

jsqr.js is the unmodified jsQR 1.4.0 browser distribution (Apache-2.0).
Source: https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR
Its exact npm version is locked as a dev dependency. It powers in-app camera
scanning without native BarcodeDetector support. License: jsqr.LICENSE.
